opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, holding a permanent or fixed-term position covering the duration of the award, with both teaching and admin duties, based in a UK University or UK not-for-profit research organisation. Up to two Co-applicants from different Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Cross-disciplinary, curiosity-driven research awards in partnership with the Royal Society, Royal Academy of Engineering and Leverhulme Trust, promoting interdisciplinary collaboration across science, engineering, social sciences and humanities.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK who meets the conditions of the call; previous successful recipients of this award are not eligible to reapply.
opportunities.summary: Public engagement programme supporting ambitious projects to engage the public with the humanities and social sciences, working in partnership with a GLAM organisation or performing arts organisation.

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers affiliated with research institutions in the UK or Germany, in the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Research collaboration symposium on the theme 'Humans and Nature: More resilient towards the future', bringing together early career researchers from the UK and Germany to encourage collaboration and networking, with seed funding available for international collaborations.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships

amount.raw: 80% of salary costs, directly allocated and indirect costs under FEC; three year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers in humanities and social sciences based at a UK university or recognised research organisation; British citizens/EEA nationals or anyone with a UK doctorate; completed Viva Voce between 1 April 2024 and 1 April 2027; not appointed to a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three-year fellowship for outstanding early-career researchers in the humanities or social sciences to pursue an independent research project towards a significant piece of publishable research, funded by DSIT.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities and social sciences ordinarily resident in the UK, holding a current long-term appointment at a UK-based HEI or IRO continuing for the full duration of the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK-based researchers to build skills and capacities in core areas such as quantitative skills, data science, digital humanities and languages, promoting innovative research methods, skills development, collaboration and dissemination.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: up to £300,000 over 2 years (80% FEC, total project value at 100% FEC up to £375,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Principal Investigator must be a researcher from humanities/social sciences based at an eligible UK university or research institute with an established role lasting at least the duration of the award, of postdoctoral or above status; Co-Applicants based overseas required.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK-led international interdisciplinary research projects on the theme of Mobilities, led by and grounded in the humanities and/or social sciences, collaborating across SHAPE and STEM disciplines.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based early- and mid-career researchers from across the humanities and social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Provides opportunities for UK-based early- and mid-career researchers to develop skills, networks and careers in policy sectors, embedded in the office of the German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) in Berlin, addressing foreign and security policy challenges.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: up to £4,000 (in exceptional circumstances above £4,000 within reason)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award-holders on any scheme OR applicants intending to apply for a British Academy award in the next six months, who meet the eligibility requirements of the scheme they intend to apply for.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support additional needs that applicants and award-holders may require, such as specific equipment to overcome barriers to disabled people undertaking research, caring costs for research trips, and assistance for applicants requiring support to make an application.
